lines.text: Many learners say: The tickets are finished.
Better: The tickets are sold out.
Sold out means none are left to buy.
Sold out! We can't go. The show is sold out.

data.why: Sold out means none are left to buy.

quiz.stem: We can't go. The show is ___.
